argus-final.name: argus-final
argus-final.notes: CADC argus 1.0.27, the OpenCADC CAOM2 TAP service, from its vendor image images.opencadc.org/caom2/argus over PostgreSQL 17 + pgsphere (benchmarks/tap-compare/docker-compose.argus.yml), serving the exported ObsCore corpus as a plain caom2.ObsCore table in place of its Observation-join-Plane view; configuration in benchmarks/tap-compare/targets/argus/, rationale in argus/PROTOCOL.md. Under final/pins/argus.yml: cpuset 8-15. Unchanged between the phases, with its UWS job store truncated before each.

dachs-final.name: dachs-final
dachs-final.notes: GAVO DaCHS from the Debian gavodachs2-server package (benchmarks/tap-compare/docker-compose.dachs.yml), serving the exported ObsCore corpus via //obscore#publishObscoreLike, under final/pins/dachs.yml: cpus 8 on cpuset 16-23, 8 GiB, its bundled PostgreSQL sized to the container by the 1/4 rule. Unchanged between the phases.

egernia-final-w1.name: egernia-final-w1
egernia-final-w1.notes: Phase A. The repository's own docker-compose.yml stack (seeded with `uv run --group dataset python -m egernia_dataset.seed`, ivoa.obscore the denormalised table of PR #160, no TAP_QUERY_DATABASE_URL — one database) under benchmarks/tap-compare/final/pins/egernia-w1.yml: cpuset 0-7, 8 GiB as 4 db / 2 api / 2 executor, TAP_API_WORKERS=1.
